subject: Azure co-sell: assurance package upload & transfer instructions for AcmeCloud listing
messages:
From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@acmecloud.com>
To: marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: partner-ops-azure@microsoft.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure listing — assurance artifacts and upload questions

Hi team,

We're prepping the listing for AcmeCloud + Redwood in the Azure marketplace. Can you confirm the preferred ingestion method for security artifacts (SOC2, pen test letter, DPA) and whether a control mapping to Azure's template is required at submission time? We have a redlined DPA we can share; want to make sure it goes to the right intake channel.

Also: timeline is tight — the co-sell kickoff is scheduled for Aug 7. Ideally artifacts are in the portal or SFTP by Aug 3.

Attachments: none (we're sending via our security team once you confirm).

Thanks,
Lauren
Head of Partnerships, AcmeCloud

---
From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
To: lauren.price@acmecloud.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing — assurance artifacts and upload questions

Hi Lauren / Rafael,

Thanks — welcome. For Azure co-sell readiness we accept artifacts in two ways:
1) Partner Center upload (recommended) — see partner portal listing page for the submission form.
2) Secure SFTP drop for sensitive reports (SOC2 / pen tests) — if you prefer SFTP we will provide a one-time folder and retention instructions.

A control mapping template is not strictly required at intake, but it speeds the review and prevents back-and-forth. If you can use Microsoft’s template, please include the mapping.

We can accept your DPA redline via DocuSign link or email attachment to partner-ops-azure@microsoft.com (internal legal will route it).

I’ve opened a case and attached the partner intake checklist. Let us know if you want the SFTP creds.

Best,
Sara M.
Azure Marketplace Onboarding

Attachments: Azure_Partner_Intake_Checklist.pdf

---
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.price@acmecloud.com, marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing — assurance artifacts and upload questions

Team — looping you in. Quick notes:

- We have the latest SOC2 Type II report (2024) and a pen test attestation for Q1 2025. Both are sensitive; I prefer SFTP to Partner Center for these.
- The legal team already prepared a DPA redline (attached) — Stephanie, can you confirm if we should send the DPA as a DocuSign envelope or to partner-ops for review?
- Sergio, please start the control mapping to the Azure template (I attached our control mapping spreadsheet draft). If anything looks like a compliance gap for Azure, flag it now so we can scope remediation before Aug 3.

Proposed plan: request SFTP creds from Azure, drop SOC2 + PenTest there, upload the Control_Mapping file to the HubSpot deal record for the Acme listing, and send DPA via DocuSign link to partner-ops.

Attachments referenced: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2024.pdf (sensitive), PenTest_Attestation_Q1-2025.pdf (sensitive), Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx, Control_Mapping_Azure_Template.xlsx

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

2) On the DPA: legal prefers DocuSign. Rafael, please confirm and I’ll fire off the envelope with the attached redline. Lauren, we’ll also copy Acme legal as requested.

SFTP drop: sftp://secure-transfer.redwood.com/acmecloud/assurance-kit (Azure-provided folder; TTL 14 days)
DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature-request/abc123-placeholder
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2025-AZ-57

I’ll aim to have the control mapping draft final by EOD tomorrow so we can push artifacts by Aug 1.

— Sergio
